title: racoon AI provenance manifest v2 (RFC 0005 "provpaws")
description: v2 adds router-mediated model identity: model_reported_by gains 'router' (a gateway answered, the backend deployment is only known from its headers) and a contribution may carry 'observed', the model ids a capture log saw on the wire. Everything expressible in v1 is expressible here; v1 manifests stay valid forever.

schema_version.description: Frozen per major version. A breaking change creates manifest-v3.schema.json; v1 and v2 records stay valid forever.

provenance_id.description: UTC timestamp plus random suffix. Must equal the manifest file name stem and the Provenance-Id trailer value.

reviewer.description: The accountable human: e-mail address as used in Signed-off-by, or GitHub handle.

statement.description: pending: written by an agent or before review; verify fails until the accountable human changes it. An AI can prepare the record but never complete the attestation.

digest.description: Digest of a privately kept session log. Proves a log existed without publishing prompts or transcripts.

ref.description: Optional opaque session reference (e.g. a tool session URL). Informational only; may not be resolvable by others.

capture.description: Binding of the capture-proxy evidence log a manifest was declared from, recorded by declare --evidence capture-log:PATH. Observations, not claims about backends: endpoints is what the capture proxy's upstream hop finally reached (an env proxy may rewrite it), window is the first/last entry timestamp the proxy wrote. A field the log never recorded stays absent, never guessed.

log_digest.description: Digest of the evidence log at declare time (sha256 of the file; with several logs, of the sorted per-file digest lines). Proves which log backs this manifest without publishing its contents.

requests.description: Log entries (proxied requests) at declare time.

endpoints.description: Origins (scheme://host[:port]) the proxy observed serving responses, deduplicated.

role.description: Role name as defined in the referenced profile (implementer, reviewer, ...).

model_reported_by.description: api: model id as returned by the provider; router: a gateway sat between harness and provider, the id is the router's label or deployment name and only the deployment headers say what actually answered; config: as configured in the harness; manual: declared by hand.

observed.description: Model identities a capture proxy or harness log saw for this contribution. Optional; absent means no capture evidence. Does not replace model_reported_by: observations from a harness log are config-trust, only router deployment headers or a provider response body approach api-trust.

files.description: Repository paths whose committed content contains output of this contribution. Empty for review-only roles.

id.description: Model id seen on the wire: response body 'model' field, router deployment header, or harness log entry.

deployment.description: Deployment name or id from a router header (e.g. x-litellm-model-name), when the observation came from a gateway.

source.description: Where the observation came from. capture-proxy: provcap-proxy.py saw the response; harness-log: a plugin/session log recorded the configured model.

requests.description: Number of requests this identity was seen on, when counted.

family.description: Model family used for the dissimilarity rule (e.g. anthropic-claude, alibaba-qwen).

id.description: Model identifier, or the organisation-managed neutral reference when disclosure is withheld.

snapshot.description: Dated snapshot / build identifier, if the provider exposes one.
